program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_p": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),
    "Lp":     (0.3, 0.15, 0.5),
    "Lea":    (0.6, 0.4, 1.5),
    "gmid_i": (18.0, 12.0, 24.0),
    "It0":    (3.5e-6, 1.5e-6, 7e-6),
    "Ic0":    (1.5e-6, 0.8e-6, 4e-6),
    "Cc":     (16e-12, 6e-12, 40e-12),
    "Ks":     (60.0, 30.0, 200.0),
    "kc":     (1.2, 0.4, 2.5),
    "Idiv":   (3e-6, 1e-6, 8e-6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VIN = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vo = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    Imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3); Imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 1e-9); Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    gp, Lp, Lea, gi = p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], p["Lea"], p["gmid_i"]
    It0, Ic0, Cc, Ks, kc, Idiv = p["It0"], p["Ic0"], p["Cc"], p["Ks"], p["kc"], p["Idiv"]

    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.05, 1.8
        for _ in range(45):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if abs(lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"]) < Id:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid
        v = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        return v, lut.op(dev, W, L, v, vds, vsb)

    def cur(dev, W, L, vgs, vds, vsb=0.0):
        return abs(lut.op(dev, W, L, vgs, vds, vsb)["Id"])

    # ---------------- bias ----------------
    Ipb, Ibc, xt = 1.0e-6, 1.0e-6, 0.33
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, Iref, vds=0.65)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, Iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mpd = lut.size("p", 14, 1.0, Ipb, vds=0.9)
    mpd = lut.size("p", 14, 1.0, Ipb, vds=mpd.vgs)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, Ipb, vds=max(VIN - mpd.vgs, 0.3))

    # ---------------- pass + sense ----------------
    Ip_l, Ip_h = Imin + Idiv, Imax + Idiv
    mp = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, Ip_h, vds=VIN - vo)
    ms = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, Ip_h / Ks, vds=VIN - vo)
    vsg_l, opl = solve_vgs("p", mp.W, Lp, Ip_l, VIN - vo)
    vsg_h, oph = solve_vgs("p", mp.W, Lp, Ip_h, VIN - vo)

    # ---------------- sense copy (MS2, saturated) -> NMOS diode ----------------
    vgsd = 0.7
    Is2_h = Ip_h / Ks
    msd = None
    for _ in range(3):
        Is2_h = cur("p", ms.W, Lp, vsg_h, max(VIN - vgsd, 0.1))
        msd = lut.size("n", 18, 1.0, Is2_h, vds=vgsd)
        vgsd = msd.vgs
    Is2_l = cur("p", ms.W, Lp, vsg_l, max(VIN - vgsd, 0.1))

    # tail adaptive current via NMOS -> PMOS mirror (MNT -> MPT diode -> MTA)
    mpt = lut.size("p", 16, 1.0, Is2_h, vds=0.9)
    mpt = lut.size("p", 16, 1.0, Is2_h, vds=mpt.vgs)
    Ist_h, Ist_l = Is2_h, Is2_l

    # ---------------- adaptive-tail differential pair (sized at heavy load) ----------------
    mi = lut.size("p", gi, Lea, 0.5 * (It0 + Ist_h), vds=0.9)

    def tail(Ist):
        vt = vref + mi.vgs
        I1 = 0.5 * (It0 + Ist)
        o1 = None
        for _ in range(4):
            v1, o1 = solve_vgs("p", mi.W, mi.L, I1, max(vt - xt, 0.1))
            vt = vref + v1
        return vt, I1, o1
    vt_l, I1_l, o1l = tail(Ist_l)
    vt_h, I1_h, o1h = tail(Ist_h)
    # MT mirrors MPD -> same gm/Id and L as MPD (mirror rule)
    mt = lut.size("p", 14, 1.0, It0, vds=max(VIN - vt_h, 0.1))

    Ifa_h = 0.5 * (1.0 + kc) * Ist_h
    mfa = lut.size("n", 18, 1.0, Ifa_h, vds=xt)
    Ifa_l = Ifa_h * Is2_l / Is2_h
    Ic_l = max(Ic0 + Ifa_l - 0.5 * Ist_l, 0.3e-6)
    Ic_h = max(Ic0 + Ifa_h - 0.5 * Ist_h, 0.3e-6)

    If0 = 0.5 * It0 + Ic0
    mf = lut.size("n", 14, 2.0, If0, vds=xt)

    # ---------------- cascodes ----------------
    Ic_mid = math.sqrt(Ic_l * Ic_h)
    mc = lut.size("n", 18, 0.5, Ic_mid, vds=0.5, vsb=xt)
    Wbc = max(mc.W * Ibc / Ic_mid, 0.42)
    vgbc, _ = solve_vgs("n", Wbc, 0.5, Ibc, 0.7, xt)
    vbc = xt + vgbc
    mpc = lut.size("p", 14, 1.0, Ibc, vds=max(VIN - vbc, 0.2))
    vgc_l, ocl = solve_vgs("n", mc.W, mc.L, Ic_l, 0.6, xt)
    vgc_h, och = solve_vgs("n", mc.W, mc.L, Ic_h, 0.5, xt)
    x_l, x_h = vbc - vgc_l, vbc - vgc_h

    # ---------------- PMOS mirror load ----------------
    ml = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, Ic_h, vds=0.9)
    ml = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, Ic_h, vds=ml.vgs)

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpd)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", mt)
    n.dev("MPC", "vbc", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpc)
    n.M("MBC", "vbc", "vbc", "rbc", "vss", "nfet", Wbc, 0.5)
    n.R("RBC", "rbc", "vss", xt / Ibc)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "fb", "tail", "tail", mi)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vref", "tail", "tail", mi)
    n.dev("MF1", "x1", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mf)
    n.dev("MF2", "x2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mf)
    n.dev("MFA1", "x1", "sn", "vss", "vss", mfa)
    n.dev("MFA2", "x2", "sn", "vss", "vss", mfa)
    n.dev("MC1", "y1", "vbc", "x1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("MC2", "g", "vbc", "x2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "y1", "y1", "vin", "vin", ml)
    n.dev("M4", "g", "y1", "vin", "vin", ml)
    mpm = max(1, min(200, int(math.ceil(mp.W / 40.0))))
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=mpm)
    n.dev("MS2", "sn", "g", "vin", "vin", ms)
    n.dev("MSD", "sn", "sn", "vss", "vss", msd)
    n.dev("MNT", "pt", "sn", "vss", "vss", msd)
    n.dev("MPT", "pt", "pt", "vin", "vin", mpt)
    n.dev("MTA", "tail", "pt", "vin", "vin", mpt)
    n.C("CC", "vout", "x2", Cc)
    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = R2 * (vo / vref - 1.0)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    beta = vref / vo
    Gdiv = 1.0 / (R1 + R2)
    gm_pl, gds_pl = abs(opl["gm"]), abs(opl["gds"])
    gm_ph, gds_ph = abs(oph["gm"]), abs(oph["gds"])

    def stage1(o1, oc, Ic, Ifa, vsgp):
        gm1, gds1 = abs(o1["gm"]), abs(o1["gds"])
        gc, gdc = abs(oc["gm"]), abs(oc["gds"])
        gx = mf.gds + gds1 + mfa.gds * Ifa / Ifa_h
        Gdn = gdc * gx / (gc + gdc + 1e-15)
        vs4, o4 = solve_vgs("p", ml.W, ml.L, Ic, max(vsgp, 0.2))
        Gup = abs(o4["gds"])
        return gm1 / (Gup + Gdn), gm1, gc, Gup, vs4
    A1_l, gm1_l, gc_l, Gup_l, vs4_l = stage1(o1l, ocl, Ic_l, Ifa_l, vsg_l)
    A1_h, gm1_h, gc_h, Gup_h, vs4_h = stage1(o1h, och, Ic_h, Ifa_h, vsg_h)
    Ap_l = gm_pl / (gds_pl + Gdiv); Ap_h = gm_ph / (gds_ph + Gdiv)
    T0_l = beta * A1_l * Ap_l; T0_h = beta * A1_h * Ap_h

    CG = abs(mp.cgg) + abs(ms.cgg) + abs(ml.cdd) + abs(mc.cdd) + abs(mp.cgd)
    ugf_l = beta * gm1_l / (2 * PI * Cc); ugf_h = beta * gm1_h / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2_l = gm_pl / (2 * PI * CL) * Cc / (CG + Cc)
    p2_h = gm_ph / (2 * PI * CL) * Cc / (CG + Cc)
    pc_l = gc_l / (2 * PI * Cc); pc_h = gc_h / (2 * PI * Cc)
    pm_l = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / p2_l)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / pc_l))
    pm_h = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_h / p2_h)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_h / pc_h))

    def psrr(T0, ugf, gds):
        f = 1e3
        T1k = T0 / math.sqrt(1 + (f * T0 / ugf) ** 2)
        fol = gds / abs(complex(gds + Gdiv, 2 * PI * f * CL))
        return 20 * math.log10((1 + T1k) / fol)
    psrr_l = psrr(T0_l, ugf_l, gds_pl); psrr_h = psrr(T0_h, ugf_h, gds_ph)

    dVg = abs(vsg_h - vsg_l)
    A1_avg = math.sqrt(A1_l * A1_h)
    load_reg = dVg / (beta * A1_avg) / (Imax - Imin) + 0.05
    line_reg = max((gds_ph / (gds_ph + Gdiv)) / (1 + T0_h), (gds_pl / (gds_pl + Gdiv)) / (1 + T0_l))
    iq = Iref + Ipb + Ibc + It0 + 3 * Ist_l + 2 * Ic_l + Idiv
    undershoot = 3.0 * (1.3 * dVg * CG / Cc + 0.03)
    dI = Gup_l * abs(vsg_l - vs4_l)
    vout_err = 100 * (dI / gm1_l) / vref + 100 * (1.0 / max(T0_l, 1.0)) + 0.01

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": undershoot,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": min(psrr_l, psrr_h),
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "ripple_settled": 0.003,
        "psrr_1k_heavy": psrr_h, "psrr_1k_light": psrr_l,
        "T0_light_db": db(T0_l), "T0_heavy_db": db(T0_h),
        "ugf_light": ugf_l, "ugf_heavy": ugf_h, "p2_light": p2_l, "p2_heavy": p2_h,
        "pc_light": pc_l, "pc_heavy": pc_h,
        "pm_light_deg": pm_l, "pm_heavy_deg": pm_h, "C_gate": CG, "W_pass": mp.W,
        "v_tail_l": vt_l, "v_tail_h": vt_h, "x_light": x_l, "x_heavy": x_h,
        "Ist_h": Ist_h, "Ic_h": Ic_h, "Ic_l": Ic_l, "vbc": vbc, "dVg": dVg,
    }
